Subject: MAP kickoff + hosting options question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency/throughput benchmarks. We're starting to assemble a formal mutual action plan (MAP) and need to lock the hosting model and primary region as part of the contract checklist.

Top constraints for us:
- PHI handling for a small subset of traffic (HIPAA scope) — possibility of on-prem or VPC-only flows
- Predictable throughput for peak inference windows (evening batch scoring)
- Procurement wants an estimate of monthly committed spend vs pay-as-you-go so they can size the PO

At a high level we're evaluating: Hosted (fastest onboarding), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools), Private (VPC / on-prem). Can you share a short recommended evaluation plan and proposed close timeline for this decision? We want to present something to procurement by next Friday (6/19).

I attached a draft MAP they started (MT_MAP_v2) — I'm including procurement on this thread.

Thanks,
Tara

Tara — appreciate the context and the draft MAP. I pulled together a compact evaluation plan that targets a procurement-ready recommendation by 6/19 and a short pilot window. Key points below; full MAP attached (MT_MAP_v3.xlsx).

Short recommended path (3-week cadence):
1) Day 0-3: Security/compliance gating — SOC 2 attestation and data flow mapping. Rishi: can you lead the SOC2 Q&A and confirm whether VPC + customer-managed keys are required for the PHI subset?
2) Day 4-10: Functional eval — run a 48–72 hour throughput/latency sweep across: Hosted (redwood-hosted/us-west), Dedicated (1x reserved pool, same region), and Private (VPC-connected test cluster). We'll instrument token-cost and tail-latency.
3) Day 11-18: Cost & SLO recommendation — we produce a short scorecard (latency, cost/token, operational overhead) and a suggested contract lane (Hosted w/ dedicated reserve or Dedicated commit or Private).
4) Day 19+: Mutual action plan signature and pilot kickoff (canary with <1% production traffic).

Proposed timeline to hit procurement deadline:
- Recommendation to procurement: Friday 2026-06-19 (high level, with scorecard and suggested lane)
- Pilot kickoff: target 2026-07-06 (2-week pilot)
- Go-live: target 2026-08-03 (subject to pilot results and SOW)

Attachments: MT_MAP_v3.xlsx (finalized tasks/owners), SOC2_questions.pdf, redwood-hosting-comparison.png

Tara — happy to hop on a 30-min call today to walk through the scorecard if that helps procurement. Rishi and Monica are looped for technical and success planning.

Best,

On Tue, Jun 16, 2026 at 10:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Tara — appreciate the context and the draft MAP. I pulled together a compact evaluation plan...

Quick tech notes from my side (will populate SOC2_questions.pdf answers by EOD):
- PHI path: If MedTech can accept VPC (Redwood Private) for PHI calls and Hosted/Dedicated for non-PHI, we can implement request-routing at the API layer. That avoids a full private-only deployment and keeps onboarding time low.
- Dedicated pool: For your peak scoring windows, I recommend a 2-GPU reserved pool (A100-equivalent) as a minimum for predictable tail latency; we can bench with your sample workloads and adjust.
- Latency parity: Expect best-case parity between Dedicated and Hosted in same region; Private (VPC) may add ~5–20ms depending on NAT/transit and customer network. We'll measure and include in the scorecard.
- Instrumentation: We'll export token-level cost and p50/p95/p99 latency to the shared MAP Google Sheet. Monica: can your team provide 48 hours of representative traffic (subset) so we can run the sweep?

I'll join the call with Tara if scheduled.

-Rishi
